name: EVMap
tagline: Find a charger for your electric car
description:
EVMap shows you electric vehicle charging stations on a map, using the community-maintained directories from GoingElectric.de and Open Charge Map. Tap a station to see the connectors, power, who runs it and what other drivers have said about it.

You can search for a place, filter hard on the things that matter — plug type, minimum power, network, free charging — and save those filters as profiles. Favourite the chargers you use often, and open the map on your car's screen through Android Auto or Android Automotive. No ads.

Live availability, showing whether a plug is actually free right now, and the built-in price comparison only work in Europe. The F-Droid build uses OpenStreetMap rather than Google Maps. EVMap is not an official app of GoingElectric or Open Charge Map — it just uses their public data.
